in_marathi.name: Sharvilayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvilayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvi means God's abode and Layan means scholarly. This name is for a child who is destined to be a place of refuge for God and to be a wise and learned individual.
